description.text:
Final Flame Dance (终末炎舞) was the fourth enhanced expansion (强化包) of the Sword & Shield series, on sale from 26 April 2024 in six-card packs with two holos, 20 packs to a box. Volcarona V is on its cover.

It brought Single Strike Entei, Rapid Strike Lapras, and the Fusion Strike Pokémon Oricorio and Meloetta; Deoxys, which is a Single Strike, Rapid Strike and Fusion Strike Pokémon all at once; Galarian Articuno; Inteleon V and VMAX, a Rapid Strike pair whose Ability and attacks reach the opponent's Bench; Suicune V; Ludicolo, whose Ability adds 100 damage to your Basic Pokémon's attacks in the turn it evolves, and Zoroark, which can turn into a Stage 1 Pokémon from your discard pile; and badges, Pokémon Tools made for Eevee's evolutions. Its main cards are numbered out of 63; full-art, Character Super Rare, rainbow and gold cards run to 83.
